task: EMERGENCY V3 AUTHORITY/RECOVERY LANE — issue #519 requires the retained Phase 4C R5 source snapshot, compose, scripts, remediation evidence and retention manifest to be archived/checksummed, but the completed OAuth investigation proved those authoritative artifacts are absent from Git. The retained host status proves /opt/ed-finder exists and the live retained container is named edfinder-v3-phase4c-full-20260827_r5-postgres. Work from current origin/main. Do not access production yourself, deploy, use secrets, query the database, mutate the host, or change DNS. Implement a narrowly allowlisted READ-ONLY ed-new operator operation that can safely identify and recover the retained NON-SECRET V3 runtime/source contract as a GitHub Actions artifact. Use Docker metadata/labels (without environment values) to identify the exact compose project working directory/config files for the named retained V3 container instead of guessing paths. The remote operation may inspect filesystem metadata and copy only explicitly allowlisted source/config/documentation types needed to reconstruct V3 (compose YAML, Dockerfile/container build files, .sql/.sh/.py source, non-secret .md/.txt/json manifests and retention/remediation evidence). It must exclude and fail closed on .env files, secret/credential/token/key/cert files, Docker inspect Env, database dumps/data/volumes, logs, backups, pgBackRest contents, SSH material and symlinks escaping the resolved source root. Add bounded file-count/total-size limits, a manifest of relative path/size/mode/SHA-256, archive SHA-256, and machine-readable receipt proving db_access=false and host_mutation=false. Do not print file contents to Actions logs. Reuse/require pinned SSH known-host trust; do not introduce ssh-keyscan trust. Prefer putting complex allowlisting/archive logic in a tested scripts/operator helper with minimal workflow glue, so it can merge cleanly with the PG18 hardening PR. Add tests covering secret-name rejection, path traversal/symlink escape, size bounds, Docker metadata parsing and no-DB/no-mutation contract. End with exact operator operation name, artifacts produced, safety exclusions, files changed, tests run, and implementation branch/commit.
